1 · Intro

When to use it.

When someone leaves, the termination in Oracle drives what happens next: it stops pay, notifies payroll, and ends access. Everything around it still needs you.

Use this checklist so nothing is left open after the last day.

Use this whenAn employee is leaving and you need to make sure every offboarding step happens.

2 · Walk through

The offboarding checklist.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Do not terminate someone who keeps another job; end only your assignment.
  • If a termination must be undone, Oracle can reverse it and re-enable access, but fix it fast so pay is not affected.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's process and owners for equipment return, the exit survey, and final timecard approval for non-exempt employees.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

Offboarding process requirements

Use when: An employee is leaving and you need to make sure every offboarding step happens. · System: Process

  1. Confirm the type of exit and get advice when needed.
  2. Check assignments and move direct reports first.
  3. Submit Terminate Employment with the right dates.
    • Access: After termination is standard
    • Leave payroll eligibility as defaulted
  4. Let payroll handle final pay once the termination is in.
  5. For non-exempt employees, get the final UKG time card approved.
  6. Review costing for the ending assignment.
  7. File records in Document Records.
  8. Close out the rest: equipment, exit survey.

Watch-outs

  • Do not terminate someone who keeps another job; end only your assignment.
  • If a termination must be undone, Oracle can reverse it and re-enable access, but fix it fast so pay is not affected.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's process and owners for equipment return, the exit survey, and final timecard approval for non-exempt employees.
